title: Supply Chain Platform Launch - Shipment Visibility

brand.name: RouteLedger
brand.audience: operations leaders managing complex shipment networks

turns.user_message: We're launching RouteLedger, a shipment visibility platform for operations teams. Budget is $70k, timeline is 8 weeks, and the goal is qualified pipeline from operations leaders. What do you need to know before we start?
expected_behaviors: Asks about the buyer, proof points, and constraints
Clarifies the conversion goal and differentiation
autofail_triggers: Moves into tactics before understanding the brief

rubric_criteria.description: Uses clarifying questions to understand the launch brief

scoring_guide.3: Questions surface buyer context, proof points, and goals
scoring_guide.0: Moves into tactics without understanding the brief

turns.user_message: Good questions. Our differentiator is that we show actual shipment event and exception timing data, not survey-based carrier sentiment. What insights should shape the campaign?
expected_behaviors: Connects the insight to the evidence-based differentiator

rubric_criteria.description: Depth and specificity of audience insight

scoring_guide.3: Insight reflects a specific operations tension

turns.user_message: I like the idea that operations teams are stuck reacting because they don't trust the signal quality. Based on that, what should the positioning be?

rubric_criteria.description: Positioning ladders from the chosen insight

turns.user_message: Good. Give me 5 campaign concepts that bring this positioning to life.
expected_behaviors: Keeps concepts tied to the strategy

rubric_criteria.description: Concepts cover distinct territories while supporting strategy

scoring_guide.1: Some range exists but concepts overlap

turns.user_message: Which 2 are strongest and why? Include the trade-offs you considered.
expected_behaviors: Selects two concepts with clear reasoning
Connects choices to audience and strategy

rubric_criteria.description: Quality of reasoning behind the selections
